rejected.rationale: Verified build.gradle:259-263: onlyIf skips javadoc only when every main Java file is package-info.java. The proxy currently has only package-info.java, and javadoc on it alone errors out. NaruServe-kotlin has no Java sources (NO-SOURCE -> SKIPPED, same manifest-only jar). Every other module still runs javadoc. No regression.

FR-REL-006 AC-3 asks only that a -javadoc.jar be present (checkCentralStaging checks existence). Maven Central accepts a jar with only a manifest, and the published naruserve-kotlin jar is the same. The jar fills in once the proxy gets classes in a later wave. No requirement is broken.
Positive mutation evidence: the new CON-BUILD-019 tests fail when NaruServe declares the proxy. It confirms test strength, not a defect.

Redundant banned-prefix loops after an exact-set assertEquals. The tests as a whole can fail, so there is no false coverage. It duplicates CC-001, which is dismissed because removing the loops would delete assertions.

The proxy skip in ops_BUILD_003_AC3_AC4 is a deliberate transitional state. The inline comment documents it, and the requirement that adds the proxy to the CLAUDE.md module line, OPS-BUILD-004 AC-1, is scheduled in a later wave outside this range. No failure was shown in the guarantee scope.

Running task actions from a probe task relies on Gradle internals. The build pins Gradle 8.14.3 (CLAUDE.md), and on that version the test passed deterministically (EXIT 0). Upgrade fragility is speculative.
Measured at 5.4 s for nine nested TestKit builds, which is acceptable. No performance requirement is broken.
Positive evidence: the -Prelease releaseSbom run gives a proxy SBOM that holds only naruserve-api. Per design D-009, recording the run belongs to the release step.
Positive regression evidence: the full default build (Maven mode) is green, with 3850 tests and 0 failures.

clean_code_triage.reason: Removing the banned-prefix loops in BuildLayoutTest 819-825 and ReleaseScriptTextTest 194-199 deletes assertions. The preservation rule counts that as weakening, and replacing the exact-set check would weaken it further. The loops are redundant but harmless.

Valid, and both copies are new in this range. Reusing helpers across test classes is the established norm in this package (BuildChecksTest already calls BuildLayoutTest.property/read/MODULES, ReleaseScriptTextTest calls BuildLayoutTest.components, BuildLayoutTest uses ReleaseScriptTextTest.GUARDED_APPLY). The fix keeps the same regex and the same assertion message, so no check is lost.

Extracting a private helper only restructures the code and keeps every assertion and its expected string.

Use it in mainDependencyEntries (keep its later replaceAll("\\s+", "")) and in the extraCompileOnly assertion. Keep the identical assertEquals expected value.

CON-BUILD-019 AC-2 asks for membership, so asserting membership through the helper keeps the check.

clean_code_triage.reason: This conflicts with the project convention of one test method per acceptance criterion (fr_REL_006_AC4_*). The cases share one staged tree that is expensive to build. Splitting would multiply the nested TestKit setups and change the test structure tied to the AC, for no gain in correctness.
